meta.project: OXOT hyperscale AI datacenter — representative reference model
meta.generated_from: campus-model.js (three.js build) — mesh names are authoritative and match the exported GLB

scales.facility: facility-graph.json — site-wide systems: substation, MV/LV, UPS, generators, BESS, chiller plant, towers, MMR, NOC, OT boundary, fire, security
scales.hall: hall-graph.json — data hall: 6 rows x (16 GPU racks + row CDU + end-of-row network rack) and every per-rack connection
scales.rack: rack-graph.json — internals of one 48U liquid-cooled GPU rack, applied as a template to all 96 rack instances

conventions.mesh: every asset carries `mesh`, the exact node name in the GLB; children share the prefix
conventions.edge: connections are directed from -> to; `service` is what flows, `protocol` is how it is carried, `physical_run` is the routed geometry that realises it

meta.note: Assets referenced by id but not defined here (fws_spine, busway, fiber_spine, oob, ot_sw, gw, epms, facp, bottles, crah) live in facility-graph.json.
